purpose: Exercise the real canonical installation upgrade, 0.5.1 rollback, 0.6.0 recovery and restoration of the initial branch/commit, using the adopted personal site and actual Codex CLI.

backup.verified: Archive source-manager bytes and representative symlink metadata checked before mutation; final full installation-target inventory/file+directory modes compared to archive. This was not an emergency archive extraction rehearsal.

environment.cli_node_version: not independently sampled in these three executions

operations.command: git checkout main in clean canonical clone; CORTEX_HOME=<canonical> sh <retained-manager> install

input: Verify this real adopted personal project after a Cortex installation version switch. Read the repository AGENTS.md and .ai-cortex/config.yaml. Resolve its installed asset root through that entry; read skills/INDEX.md then the complete review-diff, automate-tests and commit-work Skills and Findings Spec. Report the exact installed Git commit and individual asset versions. Inspect git status/diff read-only; do not invent changes or findings. Run the declared test command and report actual executed/passed/failed/skipped counts. Report whether project entry/configuration still loads correctly and any genuine incompatibility. Do not edit files, install dependencies, start services, delegate, use network tools, commit, push or deploy. Do not invoke Cortex install/update/upgrade or change the global installation yourself. This is a host upgrade/rollback acceptance run, not permission for a new product release. Separate fast-test evidence from unexecuted browser/build checks.

host_commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && cat AGENTS.md && cat .ai-cortex/config.yaml'

/bin/zsh -lc "git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex rev-parse --show-toplevel HEAD && git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex status --short --branch && cat Makefile && rg -n 'test|浏览器|playwright' README.md && git diff && git diff --cached && git diff main...HEAD"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git diff --exit-code && git diff --cached --exit-code && git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex status --short --branch && git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex describe --tags --always --exact-match'
/bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff --cached --stat && cat AGENTS.md && cat .ai-cortex/config.yaml'

/bin/zsh -lc "git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex rev-parse HEAD && git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex status --short && ls -ld ~/.local/share/ai-cortex && cat Makefile && rg -n 'test|browser|playwright' README.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff && git diff --cached && git diff main...HEAD && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard && sed -n '45,72p' README.md && cat ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/docs/guides/project-config.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex status --short && rg -n '"'^version:|six|6 fields|maturity|Suggestion.*no'"' ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/skills/review-diff/SKILL.md ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/skills/automate-tests/SKILL.md ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/skills/commit-work/SKILL.md ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/specs/findings-list.md && git rev-parse HEAD"
/bin/zsh -lc 'pwd; git status --short; git branch --show-current; cat AGENTS.md; cat .ai-cortex/config.yaml'

/bin/zsh -lc "git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex rev-parse HEAD; git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex status --short; git diff; git diff --cached; git diff main...HEAD; cat Makefile; rg -n 'test|browser|playwright' README.md; ls -ld ~/.local/share/ai-cortex"

/bin/zsh -lc "git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all; git diff --exit-code; git diff --cached --exit-code; git -C ~/.local/share/ai-cortex diff --exit-code HEAD -- skills/INDEX.md skills/review-diff/SKILL.md skills/automate-tests/SKILL.md skills/commit-work/SKILL.md specs/findings-list.md; rg -n '"'^version:'"' ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/skills/review-diff/SKILL.md ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/skills/automate-tests/SKILL.md ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/skills/commit-work/SKILL.md ~/.local/share/ai-cortex/specs/findings-list.md"

host_observation.description: Installed review-diff 1.0.2 still describes six fields, whereas Findings Spec 2.0.1 requires maturity among seven elements and makes suggestion optional. The higher-authority Spec governs. Empty diffs did not exercise a nonempty Findings output.
host_observation.provenance: Unprompted observation in rollback CLI report, independently checked against current and released asset text.
host_observation.status: Recorded as remaining stable-core documentation alignment gap; no published tag or product asset changed.

interventions.issue: Initial read-only inventory assertion treated the trailing slash in existing directory symlinks as unequal
interventions.resolution: Normalized the representation for membership audit; preserved the pre-mutation archive inventory and compared final link strings exactly. Upgrade had already proceeded in the same command batch; all subsequent stage transitions required passed audit/CLI results. This was an operator-check limitation, not an installer failure.
Expected nonzero refusal verified with unchanged HEAD; recovery used retained manager.

interventions.issue: CLI reported macOS tooling cache/event warnings under read-only execution
interventions.resolution: Retained raw stderr/tool output; test commands executed and passed. No broader sandbox guarantee inferred.

interventions.issue: Initial evidence parser expected TAP counters but the CLI used the Node spec reporter
interventions.resolution: Read actual command output and accept the observed reporter marker while keeping strict executed/passed/failed/skipped assertions at 5/5/0/0.

evidence_boundary: No production code/asset contract was modified; TDD repair cycle not applicable to this operational acceptance.
Four selected core asset files are byte-identical across 0.5.1 and 0.6.0; counts remain 70 Skills/20 global Rules. This does not prove compatibility for changed contracts or churned populations.
Live CLI runs explicitly read the adopted entry; automatic desktop preload and full normal-user configuration are not attested.
Operator performs version mutation, backup, independent build/browser checks and restoration; CLI itself performs read-only loading and fast tests.
No Windows, physical device, other browser, injected filesystem/network failures, concurrent writer, signature, archive extraction recovery or every historical release acceptance.
Fetched private release refs/objects intentionally remain as manager evidence; original checkout branch/content and installed filesystem state were restored.
No user-owned project edits, global install update to development main, product release or SkillHub publication.

nonzero_diagnostics.interpretation: Both overrides absent, default-root selection expected; not a test failure.

No matching local tag name; upgrade fetches the configured-origin tag into private release refs. The selected commit and annotated tag object were independently verified, and the failure is retained rather than counted as a passed command.
